title: Adaptive Filtering via Canonical Systems with Time-Varying Hamiltonians
summary: In many practical applications, signals and environments are time- varying, which makes fixed filters unreliable. Adaptive filtering, on the other hand, updates in real time to suppress noise, track nonstationary signals, and identify unknown systems. This paper investigates an adaptive filtering frame- work based on canonical systems with time-varying symmetric positive semi- definite Hamiltonian matrices.
